title: On Drowning in the second flood of the spring
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：drown　|　正文 368 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 drown 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the researcher ① drowned in the second flood of the spring without a word of thanks, and every student in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the researcher ② drowns in the second flood of the spring at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ drown in the second flood of the spring at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ drowned in the second flood of the spring before — a line in the paper for February 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Drowning in the second flood of the spring without a word of thanks, the researcher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ drown the whole lower meadow at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Drown the whole lower meadow at once and never mention it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the paper, and a new student from the next lab ⑧ drowns the whole lower meadow without a word of thanks every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ drowned in the second flood of the spring again when nobody else would.

⑩ To drown in the second flood of the spring, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the lab remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the lab forgets, somebody drowns in the second flood of the spring at once again and somebody must drown in the second flood of the spring without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 淹死（一般过去式 drowned in the second flood of the spring：1982 年研究员头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 淹死（一般现在 drowns in the second flood of the spring：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 淹死（不定式 to drown in the second flood of the spring：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 淹死（过去完成时 had drowned in the second flood of the spring：1976 年二月的研究报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 淹死（动名词 drowning in the second flood of the spring 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 淹没（drown the whole lower meadow：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去淹没把下游整片草甸淹没）
G. v. 淹没（drown the whole lower meadow：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 淹死（后段两处：新来的学生照例 drowns the whole lower meadow，而母亲又一次 drowned in the second flood of the spring）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 drown 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the researcher drowned in the second flood of the spring without a word of thanks, and nobody in the lab forgot it.
Even now the researcher drowns in the second flood of the spring at once whenever the lab asks.
Drowning in the second flood of the spring without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
